description: Shipping token pairs for the single light parchment palette. Each entry is a real foreground/background combination the UI renders — not the palette in the abstract. Contrast is computed by scripts/check-contrast.mjs; text pairs need >=4.5:1 (WCAG 2.2 AA), ui/non-text pairs need >=3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). Tokens live in tailwind.config.js and are documented in DESIGN.md §2.
